en: O Avenger, take revenge on our enemies – Pardoner Compassionate, cure us and be kind to us

ar: وَيَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ اُلْطُفْ بِنَا فِيْ أُمُوْرِنَا
tr: Wa Yā Dhā ‘l-Jalāli ulṭuf bi nā fī umūrinā
en: O King of Awesome Dominion, with its subdual – O Lord of Majesty, be gentle with us in our affairs
O Equitable, with uprightness strengthen us – O Assembler, assemble our hearts for You

tr: Ghaniyyun wa Mughnin aghninā bi ka Sayyidī
Wa Yā Māni`u ‘mna` kulla karbin yuhimmunā
en: Self-Sufficient, Enricher, enrich us with You, my Master – O Preventer, ward off every distress and worry

tr: Wa Yā Ḍārru ḍurra ‘l-mu`tadīna bi ẓulmihim
Wa Yā Nāfi`u ‘nfa`nā bi anwāri Dīninā
en: O Afflicter, afflict aggressors with their own wrongdoing – O Beneficial, benefit us with the lights of our religion
